title: JITServe: SLO-aware LLM Serving with Imprecise Request Information
authors: Wei Zhang; Zhiyu Wu; Yi Mu; Rui Ning; Banruo Liu; Nikhil Sarda; Myungjin Lee; Fan Lai
affiliations: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Google, Cisco Research
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, Agentic / Workflow serving, Length prediction, Performance modeling, Continuous batching

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM request schedulers focus on aggregate performance metrics like throughput or average latency, failing to meet diverse application-level SLOs (latency-sensitive, deadline-sensitive, compound) and struggling with unpredictable request information.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 請求 scheduler 著重於吞吐量或平均延遲等整體指標，無法滿足多樣化的應用層 SLO（latency-sensitive、deadline-sensitive、compound），且難以應對不可預測的請求資訊。

key_innovation.en: JITServe, an SLO-aware scheduler that uses imprecise request information (Quantile Regression Forest-based response length upper-bound estimation and pattern-graph matching for dependency estimation) and a Grouped Margin Goodput Maximization (GMAX) algorithm to allocate just-in-time bandwidth.
key_innovation.zh: JITServe 是一個 SLO 感知 scheduler，透過不精確的請求資訊（以 Quantile Regression Forest 預估 response length 上界、以 pattern graph matching 估計請求依賴），並以 Grouped Margin Goodput Maximization（GMAX）演算法進行 just-in-time 頻寬分配。

baselines_compared: vLLM, Sarathi-Serve, Autellix, Learn to Rank (LTR)

key_improvements.en: 1.4x-6.3x service goodput improvement over state-of-the-art baselines; 28.5%-83.2% resource savings at equivalent goodput; within 3-9% of an oracle scheduler with perfect foresight.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於 state-of-the-art baseline，service goodput 提升 1.4x-6.3x；在相同 goodput 下可節省 28.5%-83.2% 資源；效能落在具完美預知的 oracle scheduler 的 3-9% 之內。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (QRF upper-bound estimator; paper reports SLO violation rates and goodput rather than length-prediction MAPE)
validation_workloads: Alpaca, LMSys-Chat, Search Arena (deep research), Math Reasoning, Agentic CodeGen, Microsoft production trace

scope_assumptions.en: QRF length predictor is conservatively biased toward upper-bound estimates and is incrementally refined every ~50 generated tokens; pattern-graph matching assumes historical workflow patterns exist for the incoming request type; evaluation conducted on 16x A100 with up to ~10K requests per run over one-hour windows; built atop vLLM and inherits its prefix-cache and chunked-prefill assumptions.
scope_assumptions.zh: QRF length predictor 偏向保守的 upper-bound 估計，並大約每 50 個 generated token 進行一次增量更新；pattern graph matching 假設新進請求類型已有歷史 workflow 樣式可比對；實驗在 16x A100 上、以一小時為窗每次處理約 10K 請求；系統以 vLLM 為底座，繼承其 prefix cache 與 chunked-prefill 設計假設。

source.updated_notes: Added inference-modeling domain + venue normalization (arXiv preprint).
